reasons.missing: The simulation runs no attachment bind on an EC2 host: no profile reads the instance metadata service, the host's NVMe mappings or the bind state directory with its `host.key`, `assignment` and `authority` files, or attaches an SPDK disk (`SpdkDisk::attach_restart`, `connect_locked`), so the attach-time authority checks, the assignment and local-record codecs and their durable writes never run.

No profile runs host failure detection, with valid or invalid detection bounds: no host encodes or sends an authenticated heartbeat, and no standby validates its bounds, builds a host detector (`Watch`), admits heartbeats, records probe votes or closes an observation window; in the workspace's non-test build only the host agent builds a `Watch` and encodes a heartbeat (`Agent::new` and `Agent::beat` in `crates/kestrike/src/host/agent.rs`), and no code of that build calls `Agent::new`.

No profile runs the reconciler service (`crates/kestrike-reconciler`), the only code of the workspace's non-test build that builds and ticks a zone's failover loop (`ZoneLoop`): no zone configuration or fleet directory, valid or not, is validated or succeeded, and no host report is read back and verified.

No profile has a reconciler reserve a standby slot in an AZ's census or act on a volume loss through a provider create, a flip or the store writes that follow, and no code of the workspace's non-test build calls a writing method of `Reconciler` either: the reconciler service's zone loop, the only `Reconciler` that build constructs, calls `store_state`, `read_census` and `read` alone.

No profile has a standby host enroll its pair in the active volume's record (`enroll_standby`), which also persists the standby's local record through the bind (`OwnerLock::persist_standby`); its only caller, `host::recover::stand_by`, has no caller in the workspace's non-test build.

No profile has a host seal a periodic host report (`report::Writer`, which no code of the workspace's non-test build constructs) or runs the reconciler service, whose loop seals each tick's status through the same envelope (`StatusWriter::seal`, called from `crates/kestrike-reconciler/src/run.rs`); a refusal there also needs a seal before the status period has passed, more zones or rows than a status holds, a sequence or due time at its limit, or a body the status decoder refuses.

No code of the workspace's non-test build flips a shard record to its spare (`flipped`): only `Reconciler::flip` and `Reconciler::flip_for` reach it, through `Reconciler::flip_read` and the store client's `Client::flip`, and that build calls no writing method of a reconciler, since the reconciler service's zone loop, the only `Reconciler` it constructs, reads through it alone; a refusal there also needs a record that names no spare other than its active volume or, with such a spare, sits at generation 2^32 - 2 or above.

No profile checks a layout against its floor (`Layout::check_floor`): none builds a volume geometry from a recorded layout (`VolumeGeometry::recorded`), places a checkpoint capture in a layout's slots (`placement::place`), opens a checkpoint reader over one (the warm start's `SlotReader`), validates a replacement layout (`ZoneConfig::validate`), builds a fleet directory entry over one (`Directory::new`), or runs the host-duty, poll (the volume authority's `poll::poll`) or reconciler step that checks one, let alone with a layout whose slot count is below `MIN_SLOTS`, whose slot units differ, in either direction, from the units its entry cap requires, or whose prefix units are below `1 + K·S`.

The simulation's serving authority (`ServingAuthority::fixture_pair_under`) runs on a clock that never advances or faults (`ZeroClock`) over a disk with no reservation commands, so no Report is sent and no serving window lapses: the serving machine gets no own-holder Report and no expiry.

The simulation's store client keeps its watermark in an in-memory log in place of the durable watermark file (`FileLog`), so no profile loads a watermark file, let alone one with a torn, zeroed or moved slot.

No profile builds failover bounds with a zero registrant maximum, retry maximum, window, report deadline or report period, with a report period plus deadline plus clock error that overflows, or with a window at or below that sum.

No profile runs the soak store's bump (`crates/kestrike/src/soak/store.rs`), which raises `E` without the `exhausted()` check, on a shard record at `ATTEMPTS_MAX`, 2^31 - 2, or above: the fresh-records, restart-judge and takeover-records steps call `exhausted()` on the same read and refuse such a record before `Client::bump` or `Client::take_over` runs.

The simulated disk has no reservation commands, no profile enrolls a host's pair in a store record and no attachment bind reads an assignment, so no reservation key is decoded from a reservation report, a local record, an enrolled pair or an assignment, and a key epoch or incarnation of 0 or 0xFFFF_FFFF there would also need such bytes.

No profile sends a WHO-HOLDS or PROBE ownership query, whose zero responder field an owner's decode (`OwnershipBody::decode`) passes to `Exhid::new`, reading the `ExhidZero` answer as no responder, and no code of the crate's non-test build sends one either; the run also lacks the other inputs that construct it: a READY or ownership body whose tenure names a valid generation and epoch with a zero host ID (`identity`), an ownership reply with a zero responder (`OwnershipBody::ordered`), sixteen zero bytes passed to the public `report_exhid`, a reservation report (`parse_extended_report`, which the simulated disk never runs, having no reservation commands) whose registrant entry passes the count, length, output, reservation-type and key checks and carries a zero host ID, a store record, local record or recorded route with a zero host ID, and an entropy draw of sixteen zero bytes for a fresh attachment's host ID.
No profile's store returns a record whose first four bytes differ from its kind's magic.

No profile's store returns a coverage page fenced above the owner's session or a regressed record (`withdraw_coverage`), and no host duty loop (`Duties`, which no code of the crate's non-test build constructs) withdraws a volume on a flip or retirement, so no later event finds the serving machine withdrawn and no metadata is submitted after a withdrawal; `admit_metadata` also refuses any metadata before the boundary or after a close and a checkpoint unit while the machine is `Recovering`, which the volume never submits: it submits metadata only once the gate's `Fenced` value is set, nothing sends `Close`, and the run at `9ca0dee8563c` (roots 1 to 50) submitted no checkpoint unit while recovering.

The simulation's serving authority starts with a serving window open at time 0 (`Machine::issued`) on a clock that never advances or faults (`ZeroClock`), so no metadata submission finds the window absent or lapsed; the other denials, a `ReadReady` under another token while `Recovering` (`Machine::readiness`) and metadata under another token or before the window starts (`admit_metadata`), no code of the workspace's non-test build sends: `authority_ready` and the volume's metadata submissions pass the machine's own token.

No profile runs a host's duty loop, which sends the serving machine `Refresh` and `ReadFailed` from its shard-record view (`crates/kestrike/src/host/duties.rs`) and `Peer` from its link inbox (`crates/kestrike/src/host/duties_status.rs`), and no code of the workspace's non-test build constructs one (`Duties::new`).

No code of the workspace's non-test build builds `TenureRefusal::Target`: the public writers `flip::taken_over`, `flip::designated`, `Client::take_over` and `Client::designate` refuse a record whose `(g, owner, E)` differs from the target or whose `E` is 0, a takeover of a record that names no standby or another standby than the successor, or a designation that names the record's owner, but their callers (`Takeover::records` in `host::recover::stand_by`, which nothing calls, and `Reconciler::designate`, which no code of that build calls) refuse those records on the same read first.
No code of the workspace's non-test build sends a serving machine `Event::Terminal`, the only input that reaches `Machine::terminal`, through the public `Machine::step` or `Owner::authority_event`.

No code of the workspace's non-test build sends a serving machine an own-holder Report that `Machine::reported_token` refuses: one under the machine token's lineage with another pair than that token's, or one certified before its submission or more than the report deadline after it; the volume submits every Report under the machine's one token and certifies it at its latest serving-clock sample, which never precedes the submission's, and times out a Report past its deadline (`authority_deadlines`) before it judges the Report's completion.

No code of the workspace's non-test build sends a serving machine `Event::Close` or `Event::Withheld`, the only ways into `Closed` and, as `Withheld` in `PreBoundary` or `Serving`, the only way to `Unsupported` besides the attach gate's crossing (`cross_boundary`), which the gate runs only while the machine is `PreBoundary`.

No code of the workspace's non-test build sends a serving machine a readiness out of order, twice or under another token, or a Report under another lineage: the only readiness sender (`authority_ready`) runs while the machine awaits readiness and sends `ReadReady`, then `AllocationReady`, under the machine's own token, every token has lineage 1, and every Report carries the token it was submitted under.
